title: Pichai says more than a quarter of new code at Google is generated by AI
summary: On Alphabet's third-quarter 2024 earnings call, CEO Sundar Pichai said that more than a quarter of all new code at Google is now generated by AI. Pichai framed the figure as the start of a broader shift, and the article does not describe how the share is measured, whether the code comes from autocomplete or agents, or how engineers review it before it ships.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17. Fortune page dated October 30, 2024 (byline Greg McKenna) confirms Pichai said on Alphabet's Q3 2024 earnings call that over 25% of new code at Google is AI-generated. The page gives no measurement method, no autocomplete-versus-agent split, and no description of the review process; the figure is a company statement reported by the press. Kept as a baseline datum on AI-written code shipping at scale with human review as the implied control, not as an agent-specific event.
